settings.title: Settings
settings.activeCountryHint: Determines which institutions and donations you see. Switching country never changes donations you've already submitted.
settings.switchPreferenceLabel: Suggest a switch when travel is detected?
settings.corporateAlreadyLinked: This account is already linked to a company account.
settings.corporateHint: If your company has a partnership with Wafina, enter the code provided by the Admin.
settings.privacyHint: If enabled, the institution that accepts your donation sees your name and phone number on the donation card, so they can arrange pickup with you. Otherwise, the donation appears without personal identification — the institution only sees the location and address you provide.
settings.impactFeedHint: Private shows only stories about your own donations. Public also shows approved stories about other people's donations, so you can see the impact of the whole Wafina community.
settings.notificationsHint: In-app notifications are always on. You can also choose to receive a personalized email whenever an impact story about one of your donations is published.
settings.devOptionsHint: Simulates the GPS-detected country without needing a VPN or a fake-location app. Never appears outside a development build.
settings.deleteAccountHint: Permanently deletes your profile and access to your Wafina account. Your history of already-delivered donations may be kept anonymized for aggregate impact statistics.
settings.deleteAccountConfirmMessage: This permanently deletes your profile and access to your Wafina account. Your history of already-delivered donations may be kept anonymized for aggregate impact statistics. This action cannot be undone.
settings.medicalSupplyHint: Clean, functional medical supplies — never medication. Examples:
settings.aboutText: Wafina is developed and operated by ZUINDER.
